mappings.source_meaning: UTF-8 shorter than 16 bytes disables flow; otherwise accept only the xtls-rprx-vision prefix.
mappings.target_meaning: Omit flow when disabled; emit xtls-rprx-vision for Vision.

mappings.source_meaning: With packet-addr absent, packet/packetaddr select packet addressing; all other values and omission select XUDP.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit packetaddr or xudp explicitly; do not depend on target defaults.

mappings.source_meaning: The tls switch defaults to false; TLS and Reality options also influence connection setup.
mappings.target_meaning: BoxForge requires explicit true and a supported fingerprint for Reality; otherwise reject. Emit TLS only when enabled.

mappings.source_meaning: Native AnyTLS always uses TLS; tls is a BoxForge compatibility field, not a Mihomo AnyTLS switch.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit enabled TLS on omission or true; reject explicit false/null and unsupported Reality.

mappings.source_meaning: Mihomo declares integer seconds; BoxForge also accepts positive Go duration strings. Preserve existing rejection of zero/negative values.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit explicit seconds with s, retain accepted duration text; omit absent/null values without inventing defaults.

mappings.source_meaning: Mihomo declares integer seconds; BoxForge also accepts positive Go duration strings. Preserve existing rejection of zero/negative values.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit idle_session_check_interval using the same positive-duration interpretation as idle timeout.

mappings.source_meaning: Keep the accepted nonnegative int32 value, including zero; absence/null leaves runtime default handling unchanged.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit min_idle_session when present and non-null, preserving zero.

mappings.source_meaning: Keep explicit metadata including empty strings and whitespace; BoxForge rejects LF and UTF-8 values over 65479 bytes.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit client_metadata verbatim; omit absence/null and never invent software, version, platform or identity metadata.

mappings.source_meaning: QUIC requires TLS; tls is a BoxForge compatibility switch.
mappings.target_meaning: Require TLS, reject explicit false/null, Reality and uTLS.

mappings.source_meaning: Nonempty ports takes precedence over port; retain source order, scalar ports and explicit ranges.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit server_port for one scalar; otherwise emit server_ports as start:end ranges, including equal-endpoint ranges for list scalars.

mappings.source_meaning: Interpret Mihomo integer bandwidth units; BoxForge additionally treats plain integers as Mbps.
mappings.target_meaning: Keep only exact int32 Mbps values; reject rounding, truncation and source arithmetic overflow. Preserve zero and omission separately.

mappings.source_meaning: Use the same exact bandwidth interpretation as up.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit down_mbps without injecting a bandwidth default.

mappings.source_meaning: Integer seconds or min-max; reorder bounds, use 30s for zero, and clamp positive minimum to 5s.
mappings.target_meaning: Preserve fixed versus ranged intervals and int64 nanosecond bounds; leave omission to existing tuning.

mappings.source_meaning: Accept standard, conservative and aggressive profiles; retain omission/null.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit an explicit profile unchanged; existing tuning applies only when no profile and no positive bandwidth are supplied.

mappings.source_meaning: Accept Salamander or Gecko and preserve the nonempty raw obfuscation password.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit obfs only when enabled; empty/null disables it under the existing source schema.

mappings.source_meaning: Gecko only; zero uses the core default, otherwise accept 1..2048.
mappings.target_meaning: Keep explicit nonzero size and whether it was supplied; validate against maximum using existing 512/1200 defaults.

mappings.source_meaning: Gecko only; use the same bounds and zero-default interpretation as minimum.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit an explicit nonzero max_packet_size; retain whether the source supplied the field when null or zero selects defaults.

mappings.source_meaning: Keep the existing normalized cipher; BoxForge also accepts method as an exclusive alias.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit method without adding a cipher allowlist; official check remains the target capability gate.

mappings.source_meaning: UoT is opt-in; retain omission, explicit null, false and true.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit udp_over_tcp only when enabled; do not inject a disabled object.

mappings.source_meaning: Omission, null and zero select legacy v1; explicit 1/2 select the corresponding wire version.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit version 1 or 2 explicitly when UoT is enabled; reject other source versions even when disabled.

mappings.source_meaning: BoxForge supports only obfs; omission, null and empty string disable it.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit obfs-local with structured, validated options lowered to SIP003 text; v2ray-plugin remains rejected.

mappings.source_meaning: BoxForge requires an explicit http or tls obfs mode.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit obfs=http or obfs=tls; do not store SIP003 text in the node IR.

mappings.source_meaning: Omission/null uses bing.com; keep explicit raw text and reject blank/control-character hosts.
mappings.target_meaning: SIP003-escape backslash, semicolon and equals only during emission, preserving source text in IR.

mappings.source_meaning: Native TCP Trojan always uses TLS; tls is a BoxForge compatibility field, not a Mihomo Trojan switch.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit enabled TLS on omission or explicit true; BoxForge rejects explicit false or null.

mappings.source_meaning: Use the supplied TLS name, falling back to server; BoxForge also accepts servername and preserves its existing trimming.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit the interpreted name as server_name, including the server fallback.

mappings.source_meaning: Explicit true disables certificate validation; false enables it. Preserve omission separately.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit the explicit boolean as insecure; leave omitted/null values unset.

mappings.source_meaning: Keep explicit protocol order and duplicates, and distinguish omission from an empty list.
mappings.target_meaning: Preserve the existing alpn values and omission/empty-list serialization; this migration does not change defaults.

mappings.source_meaning: BoxForge accepts its existing shared modern profiles; empty/none selects native TLS. Other profiles remain rejected.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit supported uTLS profiles; omit utls for native TLS.

mappings.source_meaning: BoxForge accepts a 32-byte Base64URL Reality public key; keep the accepted key unchanged.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit the accepted key as reality.public_key.

mappings.source_meaning: BoxForge accepts zero to eight bytes of even-length hexadecimal, preserving case after existing trimming.
mappings.target_meaning: Emit the accepted value as reality.short_id, including an explicitly empty string.
